Iraqi militia vows retaliation against US-Saudi strikes

An Iraqi militia has vowed revenge against the United States and Saudi Arabia following recent strikes. The militia stated that missiles can only be countered with missiles, indicating a commitment to retaliatory action. This statement comes in response to unspecified US-Saudi strikes.
